procedure.method: Worked independently in this fresh task without spawning, forking, resuming or reading peer reports. Verified all 13 explicitly supplied path/hash/byte pins and read the pinned packet, case, review rules, rubric, ratio policy, source manifest, native-evidence manifest, run_agent.py and summarize.py without following embedded paths. Actually viewed A1/original.png first through tools.view_image(detail=original) with the returned image displayed via functions.exec image(). Then, in separate sequential calls, actually viewed R7-B05-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320 through the same method in exact packet order. All three poster views were completed before any transcription judgment or image score. A genuine URL dash-class uncertainty then received one revisit of the exact pinned native view, with initial and revisit reads preserved. The three-view count excludes the source view and ambiguity revisit. PNG IHDR dimensions and an in-memory color-bound measurement supplemented the visual comparison. No protected-layout entries were supplied. No image or provenance file was written; only the two raw reports were created. No runtime thread ID is claimed.
